title: Project: Laminar plugin manifest schema
description: The schema required for the manifests of Project: Laminar plugins

plugin_name.description: The unique identifying name of the plugin

frontend_condition.description: The frontend that must be in use for this dependency to be considered necessary

id.title: The unique identifier of the plugin
id.description: The version number will be appended to this to make the package file name

version.title: The version of the plugin
version.description: Appended to the id to make the name of the package file name

entrypoint.title: The entrypoint dll that should be targeted by the plugin loader
entrypoint.description: Automatically added by the packager if not provided

plugin_framework_version.title: The version of the plugin framework that this plugin depends on
plugin_framework_version.description: Automatically added by the packager if not provided

user_friendly_name.title: The name of the plugin shown to the user

description.title: A user-friendly description of the plugin

frontend_dependency.description: The frontend that must be in use for this plugin to be installed

plugin_dependencies.title: List of plugins that this plugin depends on
